citations.long: The quality control unit lacks the responsibility and authority to reject all drug products.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.

citations.short: Buildings of Suitable Size, Construction, Location
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product do not have the suitable construction to facilitate cleaning, maintenance, and proper operations.
Equipment used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products is not of appropriate design, of adequate size, and suitably located to facilitate operations for its intended use.
Failure to maintain a backup file of data entered into the computer or related system.

citations.short: Actual vs. theoretical yields not determined
citations.long: Actual yield and percentages of theoretical yield are not determined at the conclusion of each appropriate phase of manufacturing of the drug product.

citations.short: Control procedures to monitor and validate performance
citations.long: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.

citations.short: Destruction of excess labels with lot numbers
citations.long: Excess labeling bearing lot or control numbers is not destroyed.
Inspection of the packaging and labeling facilities immediately before use is not done to assure that all drug products have been removed from previous operations.
Procedures describing the warehousing of drug products are not established.
The batch production and control records are deficient in that they are not an accurate reproduction of the appropriate master production or control record.
Written records of investigations into the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications do not always include the conclusions and follow-up.
Complaint records are deficient in that they do not include the findings of the investigation and follow-up.
The drug product container and closure records do not include the results of tests or examinations performed.
